references.text: Here we see an example of God's healing power through faith, reflecting the event in Matthew where Jesus heals a man's hand.
The prophecy that the messianic age will bring healing, as demonstrated by Jesus in Matthew.
Jesus demonstrates his power to heal and forgive sins, which parallels the healing in Matthew 12:13.
A similar event where Jesus heals a man's hand on the Sabbath, showing Jesus' authority and power to heal.
Mark's version of the event where Jesus heals a man's hand, emphasizing Jesus' power and willingness to heal.
